formulas.formula: Plan every room, track every payment, and keep the surprises in check.
1. Budget: name your project, set your total budget and a contingency (10 to 20% is common), then list every line item by area and category with a budget.
2. When a quote is accepted, type it in Quote. The sheet uses it as the expected cost for that line.
3. Payments: log every payment (deposits too) against its line item and vendor.
4. Contractors: compare quotes, mark the ones you accept, and see what you still owe each one.
5. Timeline: tasks with start and end dates. Tick Done as you go.
6. Areas and Dashboard: the whole project by room and by category.
Money set aside for surprises (rot, wiring, delays). It's added on top of your line items.
For each line: the bigger of what you've paid and the quote (or the budget if no quote yet).
Expected cost minus budget. Positive = over budget on that line.
Tick Receipt on Payments so you can find them for warranties and taxes.
Clear the white cells on Budget, Payments, Contractors and Timeline.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you.
Green: paid, done, or under budget.
Yellow: in progress, or close to the limit.
Red: over budget, late, or something to check.
Thank you for your purchase! Enjoy your new space.
Every line item, by area and category. Paid comes from Payments.
The most you want to spend, all in.
Every payment, deposit and purchase. Pick the line item from your Budget.
Everyone you got a quote from. Paid adds up payments to that vendor name on Payments.
Every step of the project with its dates. Tick Done when it's finished.
Type your rooms or areas in column B (they become the Area dropdown). Numbers come from the Budget.
